title: Bags are somewhat defective
text: Bags are somewhat defective. While many of these bags worked fine, all of the jumbo bags were defective. There was serious work involved in getting replacements for these from this seller, it didn't warrant the energy it took. The bags are very hard plastic, which also makes them easy to puncture. As the air is pulled out, they have sharp edges. They hit one another and create holes. These are just not a great product.
